segments.text: When by these meanes thou art feared, and thy minde is disquieted in respect of Gods iudgement for thy sinne: haue recourse to the promises of mercie contained in the olde and new Testament. Is thy conscience stung with sinne? And doth the law make thee feele it? With all speede runne to the brasen serpent Christ Iesus, looke on him with the eie of faith, and presently thou shalt be healed of thy sting or wound.
